integrity: Original complete proof and checker are supplied for the singular-morphism classification and finite-field counts; no independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns dimension two, perfect structures, and labeled structure matrices. Finite-field checks corroborate but do not prove the arbitrary-field theorem. Primary prior results classify automorphisms and algebra isomorphism classes; possible unindexed semigroup treatments remain a novelty risk.
title: Singular endomorphisms and their finite-field census for two-dimensional perfect evolution algebras
